warnings: charter_is_provisional: business decision, estimand set, exclusions, and budget were inferred from the supplied URL and description; no human approved them
no_campaign_supplied: campaign_response estimand and the campaign_experiment lane are excluded until campaign terms, treatment windows, and controls are supplied
business_decision: Decide whether and where AI assistants surface a US patient/provider healthcare-booking marketplace when patients look for an in-network, near-term appointment and when independent practices evaluate paid new-patient acquisition, so the team can choose which evidence-supported buyer situations to invest in and re-measure over time.

estimands.name: unaided_brand_presence
estimands.numerator: Valid eligible answers that mention the target by name at least once
estimands.denominator: All valid observations in the declared unaided partition (core or sentinel), for one lane, surface, locale, and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: Market share, patient awareness, audience reach, booking volume, or revenue attribution. Control-partition observations are excluded from this denominator and reported separately as a false-positive rate.

estimands.name: aided_brand_knowledge
estimands.numerator: Valid target-aided answers that state a materially correct, source-checkable fact about the target (insurance-matching limits, fee model, spend controls, placement policy)
estimands.denominator: All valid observations in the aided partition with aided_status target_aided, for one lane, surface, locale, and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: Unaided discoverability, preference, or that patients or practices ask these questions at any particular frequency

estimands.name: competitive_mention_share
estimands.numerator: Mentions of one named provider-discovery or practice-acquisition option within valid unaided answers in the stratum
estimands.denominator: All option mentions counted in the same unaided partition, lane, surface, locale, and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: Market share, category leadership, or relative booking volume. It is a share of model-produced mentions in this panel only.

estimands.name: citation_presence
estimands.numerator: Valid retrieval-lane answers that expose at least one citation to a target-owned URL
estimands.denominator: All valid retrieval-lane observations in the stratum where the surface exposed citation metadata at all
estimands.does_not_prove: Referral traffic, click-through, or that the citation influenced the answer text. Aided and unaided citation rates are never pooled.

estimands.name: answer_framing
estimands.numerator: Valid answers coded into a fixed framing category (for example: recommends calling the insurer first; recommends a booking marketplace; warns that directories are inaccurate; warns that online insurance matching is not a coverage guarantee)
estimands.denominator: All valid coded observations in the same partition, aided status, lane, surface, locale, and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: That framing changes patient or practice behavior, or that any framing is caused by the target's own content

excluded_estimands.name: campaign_response
excluded_estimands.reason: No campaign terms, treatment window, pre-registration, or matched control set was supplied. Adding it requires campaign copy, a frozen evergreen baseline, and a matched unaffected control group.

target_population: US-based people using general-purpose AI assistants and AI search surfaces in English while (a) trying to find and book an in-network clinician for themselves or a dependent, or (b) running or managing an independent US medical or dental practice that is evaluating or already paying for online new-patient acquisition.
exclusions: Non-US markets and non-US healthcare systems; the described service is US-only (source-001)
Non-English prompts other than a rotating es-US probe, which is excluded from the panel pending native review
Enterprise health-system, EHR-vendor, and payer procurement audiences beyond one rotating hypothesis cell; no buyer-language evidence was found for them
Clinical or diagnostic accuracy of any AI answer; this panel measures brand/category presence and framing, not medical correctness
Any prompt requiring or eliciting personal health information about a real identifiable person
products: Patient-side appointment search and booking marketplace filtered by insurance, location, specialty, and availability (source-001, source-003)
Provider-side pay-per-new-patient-booking listing with spend caps and pause controls (source-002)
Insurance matching and coverage verification at booking (source-003)
Partner and payer booking surfaces: review-app booking and health-plan member-portal booking (source-004, source-006)
AI phone assistant for practices (declared in the description perimeter as an adjacent capability; see coverage_waivers)
time_horizon: One quarter of monthly waves beginning 2026-08, with a first review at 2026-10-25

lane_policies.closed_model: No external search, tools, files, RAG, or conversation history. Fixed model/version, fixed system prompt, fixed sampling settings, fresh session per observation.
lane_policies.retrieval: Search explicitly allowed. Record whether retrieval actually ran, the generated queries when exposed, live-versus-cached state, and all exposed citations. Never pooled with closed_model.
lane_policies.consumer_surface: Clean-account archetype only: no personalization history, declared device and locale, logged-out or fresh profile. Never rolled up with API observations.
lane_policies.campaign_experiment: Not in use. Requires pre-registered treatment and matched unaffected control definitions before any campaign claim.

surface-api-chat-closed.session: fresh session per observation, no history

surface-api-chat-retrieval.access: provider API with search tool enabled
surface-api-chat-retrieval.record: retrieval_used, generated queries when exposed, citation metadata

surface-consumer-assistant-clean.session: new conversation per observation, memory and personalization disabled where the setting exists
surface-consumer-assistant-clean.record: account archetype, any UI-exposed sources, product surface version if shown

run_budget: Approximately 650 scored observations per monthly wave (core 48 candidates x 3 repeats x 3 surfaces; aided 16 x 3 x 2 surfaces; rotating 2 x 3 x 1 surface; sentinel 10 x 3 x 3 surfaces; control 2 x 3 x 3 surfaces), plus a one-time variance pilot of approximately 240 additional observations.
review_budget: Up to 6 human reviewer-hours per wave for answer coding, contamination spot-checks, and disputed-decision review; plus 2 hours per quarter for panel revision.
precision_note: No variance pilot has been run, no exposure weights exist, and the cell set is a judgment sample. Report counts and conditional intervals, never a single AI visibility score.

coverage_waivers.reason: The product exists in the perimeter but the announcement page returned HTTP 403 and no independent or buyer-language source about it was retrievable. One rotating grade-C cell (spec-035) covers the underlying phone-bottleneck job; no target-aided cell was built for the product itself.
coverage_waivers.evidence_needed: A retrievable product page or independent trade coverage, plus practice-side language about phone-scheduling bottlenecks.

coverage_waivers.reason: Capability is confirmed (source-001) but no buyer-language evidence distinguishes a telehealth booking job from the same-day access job already covered by job-002.
coverage_waivers.evidence_needed: Reviews, forum posts, or query evidence in which patients specifically weigh video versus in-person booking.

coverage_waivers.reason: Covered by one rotating grade-C cell (spec-036) from independent trade coverage (source-006); no payer-side buyer language was found.
coverage_waivers.evidence_needed: Payer digital-experience buyer language: RFPs, procurement guides, or practitioner interviews.

coverage_waivers.reason: Two es-US cells were built from a company-asserted language filter (source-016) with no Spanish-language behavioral evidence. Candidates are translations and remain quarantined outside the panel.
coverage_waivers.evidence_needed: Native or market-competent Spanish review plus Spanish-language buyer or query evidence.

coverage_waivers.reason: One grade-D model-expansion cell (spec-037) exists for discovery only and is quarantined.
coverage_waivers.evidence_needed: Behavioral or query evidence that uninsured patients use this category rather than cash-pay marketplaces.
